references.text: The Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron and gave them the command to lead the children of Israel out of Egypt.
The Lord mentions that He will bring His armies, His people Israel, out of Egypt.
Fulfillment of the command: The Lord led the children of Israel out of Egypt, army by army.
All the Lord's hosts left Egypt after 430 years.
The departure of the children of Israel from Egypt under the leadership of Moses and Aaron, arranged according to their military divisions.
The Lord's first call to Moses to lead the children of Israel out of Egypt.
Aaron is appointed to be Moses' spokesperson in this mission.
You led Your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
He sent Moses, His servant, and Aaron whom He had chosen.
The Lord reminds Israel that He brought them up from Egypt and sent Moses and Aaron before them.
Highlights the transition from God's command to the actual departure under pressure from Pharaoh.
